compile_inductor_graph: compile a torch fx graph using the InductorStandaloneAdaptor with example inputs and compiler config
load_compiled_inductor_graph: load a previously compiled Inductor graph from a cached artifact handle for reuse
configure_inductor_cache: configure Inductor and Triton cache directories for vLLM compilation artifacts
compute_inductor_hash: compute a hash from vLLM config and Inductor system factors for cache key generation
run_eager_compilation: run an FX graph through the EagerAdaptor without actual compilation for fallback execution
